title: A Provision for the Trail
author: Zephyrine Brightwater
blurb: Mara Halloran, a riverboat captain who knows every sandbar's mood, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the dry season ends.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
